statement: Each motor's 37 mm lead reaches its socket on the flight controller with at least 3 mm to spare
rationale: The lead runs from the motor's base, out through the window each duct keeps on its hub side, to the socket on the board edge facing that motor (model/assembly.py motor_lead_route). A lead pulled taut pulls its plug out in the first crash; 3 mm is a small slack loop. Lead length is the listing's 37 mm (no soldering: the lead cannot be extended).
